# disconnect

Closes the communication between Tera Term and the host.

```ttl
disconnect [<confirm>]
```

## Parameters

**integer &lt;confirm&gt; (optional default=nonzero) (version 4.65 or later)**

If this parameter is zero, the Tera Term is immediately disconnected without confirmation.
If this parameter is nonzero, the confirmation dialog is shown whether the Tera Term disconnects.

## Remarks

If Tera Term is not terminated by this command, the link between Tera Term and MACRO is kept.
